title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：session　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 session 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the teacher ① held the session that no pupil in the classroom would have counted, and he said the holding was the whole of the term. The ② session, meaning the sitting itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed uncounted in the book; a session, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ session in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ session at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A session, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the teacher said the counting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the session was the whole of the matter, meaning the purpose and not the sitting. The ⑥ session, meaning the purpose and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; session, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a sitting and a purpose. He said the purpose is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ session had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ session of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of counting; session, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ session I remember is the sitting counted in the notebook, which closed in 1961 and is still counted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ session, my mother said in 1963, is the only sitting that improves by being counted; every session, she said, is a purpose that has agreed to look like a sitting. She said the purpose was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 会期；一段时间（指教室里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 会期；一段时间（指那场会期本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the session 开这一场会期
D. n. 会期；一段时间（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 会期之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的会期之事）
F. n. 会期；一段时间（指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一场）
G. n. 会期、议程（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 议程（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the session that no pupil in the classroom would have counted
The session, meaning the sitting itself and not the ruler
the session at the far blackboard
the session was the whole of the matter
the session had become a line in a notebook
The session of the whole thing
A session, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: hold the session 意为“开这一场会期”，1954 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯清点的一场会期做了一遍。
session 意为“会期；一段时间”，指那场会期本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。
session 意为“会期；一段时间”，指教室里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
session 意为“会期；一段时间”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
session 意为“会期、议程”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场议程就是那件事的全部。
session 意为“议程”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场会期，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
session 意为“会期；一段时间”，指笔记簿里写到、被清点的那一场，到 1959 年这一场成了笔记簿里的一行。
session 意为“会期之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的会期之事是一处教室和三个学期的清点。
session 意为“会期；一段时间”，我记得的是笔记簿里清点过的那一场，1961 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一场。
session 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，会期是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的会期。

那场会期，指的是那场会期本身而不是短短的尺子，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被清点。（session）
